author: GameTrailers
description:
Aztecs: The Last Sun leaves Early Access and version 1.0 is available on May 22 on PC (via Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store). Watch the Aztecs: The Last Sun launch trailer for this survival-infused city-builder game. 

Version 1.0 features enhancements to gameplay systems, new content, balance improvements, and quality-of-life updates. A new chapter is available in Story Mode alongside a new region and new game modes.
title: Aztecs: The Last Sun - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the 007 First Light launch trailer for this upcoming action game to see stealth-action gameplay, get a peek at Bond's reimagined origin story, and more. 007 First Light will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC on May 27, 2026, and in Summer 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2.

In 007 First Light, James Bond (portrayed by Patrick Gibson) steps into the world of espionage after catching MI6’s attention, beating the odds in a precarious situation in Iceland. Bond finds an unexpected advocate in M (Priyanga Burford), who sees his ability to stay in control under pressure and backs his judgment in the field. That confidence is tested by John Greenway (Lennie James), a former 00 agent and the program’s hardline training instructor, whose disciplined, by-the-book philosophy clashes with Bond’s instinctive, improvisational style. 

When the rogue return of 009 becomes the 00-Programme’s first real test, Bond is set on a journey across the world, pursuing leads from t
title: 007 First Light - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a tour of the most volcanically active world in the Malakbel system in this latest Exodus video, highlighting work-in-progress gameplay from the upcoming sci-fi action-adventure RPG. The new video showcases Jun Aslan, along with companions Elise and Phaedra, as they pass through a cave with toxic yellow mist and walls coated in condensed sulfur. We also get to see a deep volcanic crater, and a derelict starship half-buried in the landscape.

Extended gameplay for Exodus will be revealed in summer 2026.

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

Exodus is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG where you become the Traveler—leading humanity’s fight for survival against the Celestials. Face our evolution 40,000 years in the future, explore extraordinary worlds, and confront time itself to shape the fate of generations.​
title: Exodus - Official 'Into a Volcanic Hellscape' Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from Lethal Wedding in this trailer for the upcoming top-down shooter inspired by 80s action cinema and classic 16-bit games like Zombies Ate My Neighbors. Lethal Wedding will be available on Steam and Sega Genesis / Mega Drive. 

When a drug ring of criminal clowns crashes a bachelor party and kidnaps the groom-to-be, it’s up to the bride and her mother-in-law to mount a rescue. You will battle your way through psychopathic circus performers, bazooka-toting bearded ladies, and murderous mobsters across over 30 levels of carnage, all while juggling mother-daughter issues, wedding planning, and…literal jugglers.
title: Lethal Wedding - Official Steam Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Thick As Thieves is available now on Steam. Watch the Thick As Thieves launch trailer for this stealth action heist game. Thick as Thieves is playable solo or with a partner in crime in co-op multiplayer, where you will master the art of thievery. Set in the shadow-draped city of Kilcairn, where magic meets early tech, no two heists play out the same in Thick As Thieves. Adapt, improvise, and take what’s yours—before someone else does.
title: Thick As Thieves - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Reveal Trailer for Celestial Temple, a narrative-driven action-adventure game developed by Ursa Majeur. Players will embody the essence of curiosity to traverse a dreamlike realm in search of understanding where, when, and who they are. Seek the light in Celestial Temple, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#CelestialTemple #Gaming #IGN
title: Celestial Temple - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for The Guardian of Nature, a point-and-click adventure puzzle game developed by Inlusio Interactive. Players will embark on a magical hand-drawn journey with Henry. Solve puzzles through size-changing abilities, explore vibrant locales, and find items to aid the adventure. The Guardian of Nature is available now for PC (Steam).
title: The Guardian of Nature - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Burn, little Flame, burn... Light up the misty forest, dispel the darkness... Let tiny bugs emerge from the nooks and crannies, gazing at your spark.
Head over to Steam and add Pirofauna to your Wishlist.
title: Pirofauna - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Agni: Village of Calamity, a third-person puzzle exploration game developed by Separuh Interactive. Players will embody Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality. Agni: Village of Calamity is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Agni: Village of Calamity - Official Announcement Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

Hips N' Noses will launch in 2026. Head over to Steam and add it to your Wishlist.
title: Hips N Noses - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Sloppy Forgeries, a fast-paced competitive painting game developed by Playful Systems. Players will practice their skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time. Sloppy Forgeries is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Sloppy Forgeries - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

Vale's Echo will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Vale's Echo - Official Demo Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

Prison of Husk will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Prison of Husks - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Choose your own vibe in this slice-of-life adventure. While exploring a small town on rollerblades, use your MP3 player to set the mood for your summer. Run errands for quirky neighbours, get entangled in local drama, and stumble into a teenage romance.

Head over to Steam and add RollerGirl to your Wishlist.
title: RollerGirl - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

Head over to Steam and add Deep Pixel Melancholy to your Wishlist.
title: Deep Pixel Melancholy - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter, a cooking beat 'em up arcade action game developed by 3R Games. Players will fight enemy after enemy on the streets while ensuring they're properly nourished with delicious food in nick of time. Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and eerie phenomena from the region. Are you brave enough to uncover the truth?
Head over to Steam and add Blue Ridge Hunting to your Wishlist.
title: Blue Ridge Hunting - Official Kickstarter Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Jupiter Junkworks, a fast-paced arcade puzzle action game developed by Pixel Drake. Players will complete contracts to earn resources and rebuild a run-down spaceship junkyard. Dive into a sci-fi narrative campaign where an unlikely trio of travelers must learn to work together. But unknown to them, something awaits beyond the vault. Jupiter Junkworks is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Jupiter Junkworks - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
An exploration game about knowledge and discovery. Change between seasons, investigate plants, and discover secrets about the world to stop an ecological disaster.
Head over to Steam and add Forklift Flowerpot: Botanical Investigator to your Wishlist.
title: Forklift Flowerpot: Botanical Investigator - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
A desperate attempt to endure the coming Apocalypse in a cursed, unjust dark fantasy world, made only to appease a vain god. Combat is brutal, choices are lethal, and survival is a temporary insult to fate. A flail to the face.

Mork Borg Heresy Supreme is available now on PC.
title: Mork Borg Heresy Supreme - Official Launch Trailer| Six One Indie Showcase May 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Luna Abyss, a first-person action arcade bullet hell shooter developed by Kwalee Labs. Embody a prisoner that's been sentenced to traverse a sprawling, derelict megastructure to recover ancient technology from the Abyss. Take on an array of enemies, overcome enemy projectiles, and survive the horrors of the Luna Abyss. Luna Abyss is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC).
title: Luna Abyss - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Starbites is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Steam. It is also coming soon to Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the Starbites launch trailer for this RPG.

In Starbites, Lukida will do whatever it takes to get out from under her debt and get off the desolate planet where she makes her home. Unfortunately, her first real shot at escaping is stolen! Follow Lukida and her allies as they track down the missing ticket, scavenge the remains of a past war, and find out the secrets Bitter has been hiding all this time.
title: Starbites - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the combat, world, character abilities, gameplay, and more from Echoes of Aincrad in this latest trailer for the upcoming action RPG set in the popular Sword Art Online universe. As a player trapped in a VRMMORPG where death in the game means death in the real world, survival is the number one priority in Echoes of Aincrad. 

Echoes of Aincrad will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on July 10, 2026.
title: Echoes of Aincrad - Official System Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Kidbash: Super Legend trailer for this upcoming roguelike action-platformer game. The trailer gives a peek at gameplay, boss fights, and more. In Kidbash: Super Legend, awaken in a world of forgotten game characters as a hero with no memory of his past. After failing to save a nearby village from destruction, can you rise, rebuild, and rediscover the true meaning of being a hero? Kidbash: Super Legend will be available on PC.
title: Kidbash: Super Legend - Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Fatekeeper gets a new trailer and an early access release date announcement. Check out the latest Fatekeeper trailer for this upcoming first-person RPG. Fatekeeper will be in early access on June 2, 2026.

Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms. Master the art of sword and sorcery and forge your path with relics, spells, and choices that shape who you become in Fatekepeer.
title: Fatekeeper - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Cities Overview Trailer for Stranger Than Heaven, an upcoming action-adventure beat 'em up game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. With a story spanning over 50 years, you'll be visting Kokura, Kure, Minami and of course the iconic Kamurocho all the way from 1915 to 1965! 

Stranger Than Heaven is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Stranger Than Heaven - Official Cities Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Enjoy a cinematic introduction to the world of Terror: Endless Night, where players take command of a rescue vessel sent to uncover the fate of two legendary Royal Navy ships lost beneath the Arctic ice during their search for the Northwest Passage in the 1800s. Terror: Endless Night is a turn-based strategy game that incorporates tough moral choices, psychological horror, and crew management and survival mechanics in an atmospheric, story-driven narrative campaign. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878730/Terror_Endless_Night/
title: Terror: Endless Night – Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Follow Us, a 2-player first-person asymmetrical co-op horror game developed by Game Atelier. Players will stream their adventures to entertain the masses, with one player enduring frights while the other guides them from the comfort of their van. Explore spooky environments, try not to panic, and survive at all costs in Follow Us, launching into Early Access on June 5 for PC (Steam).
title: Follow Us - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Zero Parades: For Dead Spies is available now on PC (via Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store). Watch the Zero Parades: For Dead Spies PC launch trailer for this grand spy RPG. 

Hershel Wilk, a burnt out spy (cryptonym: CASCADE), returns to the city of Portofiro five years after the greatest failure of her life – the disintegration of her old network. Painfully aware of her past, now back in-theatre, she is ready to get the crew back together for one last show. On her assignment to Portofiro, you will uncover the secrets of the city, along with those of grand geopolitical powers, and the fabric of reality itself in Zero Parades: For Dead Spies.
title: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies - Official PC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Demo Reveal Trailer for Chop Chop Inc., a first-person crafting comedic simulation game developed by NullRef Entertainment. Players will build their own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp. Chop down trees, process wood, automate their growing production lines, and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets, and trees begging for violence. Chop Chop Inc. is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Wishlist the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369130/Chop_Chop_Inc/
title: Chop Chop Inc. - Official Demo Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Demo Trailer for Symbiosis, a tower defense co-op hero shooter developed by Aberratic. Players will explore procedurally generated alien planets to defend their bases from incoming threats, collect enemy genetic material for new skills, and expand their influence in any given world. Symbiosis is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC (Steam).
title: Symbiosis - Official Gameplay Demo Trailer
